content.comment_body: Hello, I'm unable to upload my program from my laptop to my [product_name] using Ethernet. I get a message saying the IP address of your PC and the target [product_name] are not in the same subnet. Even if I let the application assign the IP, I encounter an error. Manually setting the same address on my PC also doesn’t allow me to upload. Is there anyone who can assist?

Please provide more details. What is the IP address of your PC? What is its subnet mask? What is the IP address of the [product_name]? What is the subnet mask for the [product_name]? Are you connecting directly from your PC to the [product_name] or through a router?
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'PC and [product_name] not in same subnet.' Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering network configuration problems when uploading programs from a laptop to a [product_name] via Ethernet. Errors about subnet mismatches occur, and both automatic and manual IP configuration efforts do not resolve the issue, leaving program uploads unsuccessful.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily upload programs from a laptop to a [product_name] over Ethernet, without being hindered by IP or subnet configuration issues.
